headline: 蒙古凍土融化改變草原
context: 氣候暖化正在改變蒙古的景觀——草地底下的永久凍土（permafrost）融化，正在重塑當地脆弱的生態系統。另外有一則時尚消息：部分零售商正在考慮移除試衣間，相關討論開始聚焦在顧客如何確認衣服合身的問題。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The warming caused by climate breakdown in the landlocked east Asian country is transforming its fragile ecosystem As the climate crisis accelerates, Mongolia is warming rapidly, transforming the country’s cryosphere, including some of the most southerly permafrost landscapes in the northern hemisphere. Although rarely associated with the Arctic, Mongolia has a remarkably cold climate. Ulaanbaatar is the coldest capital city in the world, and a substantial portion of the country lies within the Arctic Ocean drainage basin. As a result, many of the physical and ecological processes occurring here resemble those found at much higher latitudes. People in Khövsgöl province say they have observed an increase in the number of arrivals of migratory birds from China in recent years, consuming large quantities of fish in the region’s lakes. In northern Mongolia, communities closely tied to fishing, herding and tourism are witnessing the visible transformation of fragile freshwater ecosystems shaped by climate breakdown and the changing cryosphere. Historical surveys conducted in the 1970s suggested that nearly 63% of Mongolia was underlain by permafrost. Today, estimates indicate that only 26% to 29% remains. Unlike the ice-rich permafrost of Siberia, Canada or Alaska, much of Mongolia’s permafrost is relatively warm, thin and dry, making it particularly sensitive to rising temperatures. Climate change is the primary reason for this decline, although local pressures such as overgrazing can further accelerate thaw by removing the vegetation that insulates the ground – Nikolay Shiklomanov, a professor in the department of geography and environment at George Washington University Continue reading...

蒙古凍土融化改變草原

氣候暖化讓蒙古的永久凍土融化，草原底下的生態結構正在改變，這個內陸國家的自然面貌也跟著轉型。另有時尚消息：部分商店正考慮移除試衣間，評論開始討論沒有試衣間的購物體驗會是什麼感覺。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 6 月 19 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
氣候暖化正在改變蒙古的樣子。草原底下的永久凍土（permafrost）融化，整個生態系統的結構都在隨之轉變。另外，時尚業有一個新趨勢：部分零售商在考慮移除試衣間，有評論開始問：沒有試衣間，怎麼知道衣服穿起來合不合適？

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 6 月 19 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 蒙古的樣子正在改變。草原底下的永久凍土因為暖化而融化，正在重塑當地脆弱的生態系統。時尚這邊也有一件事：有些商店在考慮移除試衣間，引發了購物體驗會如何改變的討論。
